project.title: The Case of the Missing Miniature
project.description: A sharp-witted detective takes on the peculiar case of a stolen miniature masterpiece from a renowned shop. Unravel the tiny clues and expose the truth behind the miniature world's biggest mystery.

characters.name: Maya
characters.description: A young, observant detective with a keen eye for detail. Wears a magnifying glass on a chain.

characters.name: Ben
characters.description: A practical police officer, initially dismissive of 'small' crimes. Tall and a bit gruff.

characters.name: MrChen
characters.description: The anxious owner of the Grand Miniature Emporium. Older, with spectacles perched on his nose.

characters.name: Lily
characters.description: Owner of a rival miniature gallery, known for her intricate and unique designs. Elegant and composed.

backgrounds.name: MayaOffice
backgrounds.description: Maya's cozy, cluttered detective office, filled with antique maps and strange trinkets.

backgrounds.name: MiniatureEmporium
backgrounds.description: The Grand Miniature Emporium, an elegant shop with shelves showcasing intricate miniature worlds.

backgrounds.name: DisplayCase
backgrounds.description: A shattered glass display case within the Emporium, with a spotlight illuminating an empty pedestal.

script.text: The afternoon sun streamed through the dusty window of Maya's office, illuminating the quiet boredom.
Another slow day. Perhaps the world has run out of mysteries, big or small.
Don't jinx it, Maya. I've got something for you, though you might find it... trivial.
Trivial? Officer Ben, no case is too small for a keen eye. What's the scoop?
A 'priceless' miniature, the 'Emerald Dragon,' was stolen from the Grand Miniature Emporium last night.
The Grand Miniature Emporium was a spectacle of tiny wonders, now marred by a palpable tension.
It's a disaster! The Emerald Dragon, my most prized possession, gone! Poof!
Calm down, Mr. Chen. Tell me exactly what happened. Any suspects? Any unusual visitors?
Only Ms. Lily, from the rival gallery, came by yesterday. She admired it... a lot. But she couldn't possibly...
Interesting. Let's take a closer look at the crime scene itself.
Maya knelt before the broken display case, her magnifying glass glinting in the light.
The glass is shattered, but the impact pattern is odd. And look here... a tiny, iridescent shimmer.
Glitter? Maya, what good is glitter for catching a thief?
Not just any glitter, Ben. This is 'Starfall Dust,' a signature material Ms. Lily uses in her own miniature creations. And the glass wasn't broken to get *in*.
You think Ms. Lily swapped it and then broke the case to make it look like a theft?
Ms. Lily, looking composed, was confronted by Maya and Officer Ben near the entrance.
Ms. Lily, we found your Starfall Dust near the broken display. And the 'Emerald Dragon' we recovered is a meticulous replica, not the original.
(Sighs) You're too observant, Maya. I only wanted to study its craftsmanship. I made a perfect duplicate, intending to swap it back later. The broken glass was an accident, I panicked!
A replica? My Emerald Dragon! You stole its essence!
The original was found in Ms. Lily's bag. Case closed, Officer Ben. Another miniature mystery solved.
